structure Glob (E : Env) where
  prog : Program E
  pipeline : Pipeline
  fixed : Fixed
  balance0 : Address → Word
  /-- Whether an account outside the system has code after a history. -/
  hasCode : List Event → Address → Bool
  callee : Strategy
  timestamp : Word

structure BoolSlot (E : Source.Env) where
  path : Source.SPath
  typed : E.cellTy path=.bool
  transient : E.transientRoot path=true
  key : Word

structure Parsed {X} (scope : Scope X) (tier : Tier) (outside localNames : List String)
    (src : Bytes) where
  parsed : AssemblyParse src
  prepared : Prepared scope tier outside localNames parsed.body

structure Prepared {X} (scope : Scope X) (tier : Tier) (outside localNames : List String)
    (body : Syn (.list .yulStmt)) where
  shape : body.prec = true
  finalNames : List String
  declarations : DeclarationScope.BlockD outside [] body finalNames
  placement : Placement.Derivation Placement.rootContext body
  occurrences : OccurrenceCheck.D localNames false body
  typing : ScopedBlockTyping.BlockD scope ClosedSyntax.rootEnv ClosedSyntax.rootControl body
  policy : Policy.StmtP tier typing.code

structure StateRepr (L b frame : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ)
    (σ : State C Γ) (base : Nat → Fin W) (m : Machine) : Prop where
  core : Sim C L b F σ m
  heap : HeapRepr σ.heap base frame m
  pointers : PointerRepr σ base b m
  locals : b + Γ.length ≤ frame
  structs : StructHeapRepr σ.heap base frame m
  separated : StructArraySeparated σ.heap base
  refs : RefFieldsRepr σ.heap base m

inductive InstrShape (i : Instr) (input output : Nat) : Prop where
  | mk (consumed produced suffix : Nat)
      (row : arity i = some (consumed,produced))
      (input_eq : input = consumed + suffix)
      (output_eq : output = produced + suffix) : InstrShape i input output
